purpose: 应用的主题、品牌、密度与浮层边界。 / Scope themes, brands, density and portals.
guide: 用 ThemeProvider 包裹界面；mode 管理主题，dir 管理布局和 Radix 键盘方向。方向与语言独立设置；嵌套根可继承或显式覆盖方向，浮层保持相同方向。 / Wrap the interface in ThemeProvider. mode controls theme; dir controls layout and Radix keyboard direction independently of language. Nested roots inherit or explicitly override direction; portals keep the same direction.
api: brand?: string = "neutral"; mode?: "light" | "dark" | "system" = "system"; density?: "comfortable" | "compact" = "comfortable"; style?: ThemeStyle; dir?: "ltr" | "rtl" (inherits parent direction; defaults to "ltr")
a11y: 设置页面 lang，翻译所有可访问名称。保留系统减少动态效果设置。 / Set the page lang, translate accessible names and preserve reduced-motion preferences.
pitfalls: brand 不下载 CSS；不导入品牌文件就不会获得该品牌。不要通过 body 全局覆盖主题。 / brand does not fetch CSS; import it explicitly. Do not override themes on body.

purpose: 触发保存、提交等明确操作。 / Trigger an explicit action.
guide: 同一区域突出一个 primary 操作；secondary 用于普通操作，ghost 用于低强调操作，danger 用于破坏性操作。异步请求由应用管理 loading。contrast 与 pill 可用于展示型主操作；contrast 根据明暗主题反转。 / Emphasize one primary action per region. Manage async loading in the application. Use contrast and pill for expressive primary actions; contrast adapts to the theme.
api: variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger" | "contrast" = "secondary"; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md"; loading?: boolean = false; native button props; shape?: "rounded" | "pill" = "rounded"
a11y: 使用清晰的动词标签；loading 时禁用并设置 aria-busy，标签保留。 / Use a clear verb; loading disables the button and retains its label with aria-busy.
pitfalls: 默认 type="button"；提交表单必须显式 type="submit"。不支持 shadcn 的 asChild 属性。 / Set type="submit" for form submission. Button does not expose shadcn’s asChild API.

purpose: 空间紧凑时的图标操作。 / Compact icon actions.
guide: label 描述操作而不是图形；尺寸跟随所在工具栏。 / Describe the action in label, not the shape.
api: label: string (required); icon: ReactNode (required); other ButtonProps except children and aria-label
a11y: label 是按钮的可访问名称，内部图标自动装饰化。 / label names the button; the inner icon is decorative.
pitfalls: 不要只依赖 tooltip 命名按钮。 / A tooltip is not a replacement for the button label.

purpose: 统一标签、帮助文字与错误关联。 / Connect labels, help and errors.
guide: 每个 Field 放一个 Input、Textarea、Select、Checkbox、Switch 或 Slider。错误由业务校验后传入。 / Use one field-aware control per Field; pass application validation errors.
api: label: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; error?: ReactNode; required?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; id?: string
a11y: 自动关联 label、aria-describedby、aria-invalid，并将 required/disabled 传给子控件。 / Automatically associates labels, descriptions and errors and propagates required/disabled.
pitfalls: 不要在子控件上设置不同 id；多个输入应拆为多个 Field。Field 不执行校验。 / Do not override the child with a different id. Field does not validate data.

purpose: 单行文本与原生输入类型。 / Single-line and native input types.
guide: 用 Field 提供可见标签，name 参与 FormData；受控值配合 onChange。 / Use Field for visible labels and name for FormData; pair value with onChange.
api: Native input props excluding size; value/defaultValue, onChange, type, name, autoComplete, disabled, required
a11y: placeholder 只用于提示格式，不能代替标签。 / A placeholder is a format hint, not a label.
pitfalls: 没有 onValueChange 或自定义 size 属性。不要同时传 value 和 defaultValue。 / Use onChange, not onValueChange; custom size is unsupported.

purpose: 多行自由文本。 / Multiline free text.
guide: 用 rows 设置初始高度，长内容保持可编辑与可滚动。 / Use rows for initial height and keep long content editable.
api: Native textarea props: rows, maxLength, value/defaultValue, onChange, name; Field context supported
a11y: 通过 Field 提供标签和长度说明。 / Provide a label and length guidance through Field.
pitfalls: 不要把多行输入替换成 contenteditable；组件不会自动计数或自动增高。 / This component does not automatically count characters or auto-grow.

purpose: 统一 MDS 外观的单值表单选择器。 / A consistently styled single-value form select.
guide: 使用 options 定义选项；name 参与表单提交，defaultValue 指定非受控初始值。受控模式使用 value/onValueChange。 / Define options; name participates in form submission, defaultValue initializes uncontrolled state, and value/onValueChange control selection.
api: options: readonly {value:string;label:string;description?:string;disabled?:boolean}[]; value/defaultValue?:string; onValueChange?:(value:string)=>void; name?, form?, required?, disabled?; placeholder?:string = "—"; trigger button props
a11y: combobox/listbox 语义，方向键导航、键入查找、Enter 选择、Escape 返回触发器。Field 关联标签、说明和错误；必填校验会聚焦可见控件。 / Combobox/listbox semantics with arrows, typeahead, Enter and Escape. Field associates labels and errors; required validation focuses the visible trigger.
pitfalls: alpha.4 起 Select 使用 options/onValueChange，不再接收 option children/onChange；原生 API 改用 NativeSelect。仅支持单选，value 必须唯一且非空，空字符串保留给 placeholder。受控表单重置由应用更新 value。 / From alpha.4, Select uses options/onValueChange; use NativeSelect for the former native API. Values must be unique and nonempty. Controlled resets are application-owned.

purpose: 显式使用浏览器原生选择器。 / Explicit browser-native selection.
guide: 仅需要系统选择器、原生多选或渐进增强时使用 NativeSelect；产品表单默认使用统一样式的 Select。 / Use NativeSelect for a platform picker or native multiple selection; prefer Select for consistent product forms.
api: Native select props: value/defaultValue, onChange, name, required, disabled, multiple; children: option/optgroup
a11y: 浏览器管理键盘、系统选项面板与表单重置。通过 Field 命名。 / The browser manages keyboard interaction, platform picker and form reset.
pitfalls: 这是旧版 Select 的原生实现；展开面板由系统绘制，无法匹配 MDS 浮层样式。 / This is the former native Select implementation. Its platform popup does not match MDS overlay styling.

purpose: 独立选择、多选与混合选中状态。 / Independent choices and mixed selection.
guide: 普通带标签选项优先 CheckField；自定义布局使用 Checkbox 加 label。 / Prefer CheckField for labelled options; compose Checkbox for custom layouts.
api: checked/defaultChecked?: boolean | "indeterminate"; onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean | "indeterminate") => void; name?, value?, required?, disabled?; CheckField: label required, description optional
a11y: Space 切换；indeterminate 用于父项部分选中。 / Space toggles; indeterminate represents a partially selected group.
pitfalls: onCheckedChange 不是 DOM event。不要把 indeterminate 当作 true 提交业务。 / The callback receives a value, not an event. Handle indeterminate explicitly.

purpose: 立即生效的二元偏好。 / An immediately applied preference.
guide: 用 checked/onCheckedChange 管理开关，标签保持稳定。 / Control with checked/onCheckedChange and keep the label stable.
api: Radix Switch.Root props: checked/defaultChecked?: boolean; onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void; name?, required?, disabled?
a11y: 用 Field 或关联 label 命名，Space 切换。 / Name with Field or an associated label; Space toggles.
pitfalls: 待提交的多选使用 Checkbox。不要仅以颜色描述开启状态。 / Use Checkbox for selections awaiting submission; do not communicate state through color alone.

purpose: 一组互斥的简短选项。 / Mutually exclusive short options.
guide: 每个 RadioItem 的 value 唯一，根管理 value/onValueChange。 / Give every item a unique value; manage selection on the root.
api: RadioGroup: value/defaultValue?: string; onValueChange?: (value: string) => void; orientation?, name?, required?, disabled?; RadioItem: value required, children label
a11y: 根设置 aria-label/aria-labelledby，方向键移动选择，Tab 离开组。 / Name the group; arrow keys change selection and Tab leaves the group.
pitfalls: 不要把各项当作独立 boolean；RadioItem 必须放在 RadioGroup 内。 / Items belong to one group, not independent booleans.

purpose: 需要标题、说明和图标的单选方案。 / Rich single-choice options.
guide: 选项信息较多时使用整卡选择；短选项用 RadioGroup。 / Use cards for richer choices and plain radio items for short labels.
api: RadioCardGroup: Radix Radio.Root props; RadioCard: value: string, title: ReactNode, description?: ReactNode, icon?: ReactNode, disabled?: boolean
a11y: 组必须命名；卡片自动关联标题和说明，方向键切换。 / Name the group; each card associates its title and description.
pitfalls: 卡片内不能再嵌套按钮或链接。 / Do not nest buttons or links inside a radio card.

purpose: 少量、同级互斥偏好。 / A small set of peer preferences.
guide: 用于月付/年付、密度等偏好；切换关联内容面板时用 Tabs。 / Use for preferences such as billing or density; use Tabs for content panels.
api: label: string; options: readonly { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]; Radix Radio.Root value/defaultValue/onValueChange
a11y: 使用 radio 语义，方向键选择；label 为组命名。 / Uses radio semantics and arrow-key selection; label names the group.
pitfalls: 不是 tablist，不应伪造 tabpanel 关系。 / Do not treat it as a tablist.

purpose: 在连续数值范围内调整。 / Adjust a value within a range.
guide: 显式设置 min/max/step；需要精确数值时提供数值输入。 / Set min/max/step and provide a numeric input when precision matters.
api: Native input props except type; type is range; value/defaultValue, onChange, min, max, step; Field context supported
a11y: 原生方向键调整；显示当前值，单位使用 aria-valuetext。 / Native arrow-key adjustment; expose current value and units.
pitfalls: onChange 接收事件，valueAsNumber 获取数字；不接受数组值。 / Read event.target.valueAsNumber; values are not arrays.

purpose: 紧凑的偏好选择菜单。 / A compact preference menu.
guide: 采用紧凑工具栏按钮，用于排序、密度或视图偏好，选中后立即生效。表单字段使用 Select；不要仅凭宽度区分二者。 / Use the compact toolbar button for sort order, density or view preferences that apply immediately. Use Select for form fields; width alone is not the distinction.
api: label: string; value: string; onValueChange: (value: string) => void; options: readonly {value:string;label:string;description?:string;disabled?:boolean}[]; disabled?; placeholder?: string = "—"
a11y: 非模态 menuitemradio；支持键盘选择、Escape 关闭和触发器焦点恢复。 / Non-modal menuitemradio with keyboard selection, Escape and trigger focus restoration.
pitfalls: 没有表单 name、required 或原生 reset；表单用 Select。不支持搜索或自由输入。 / No native form name, required or reset; use Select for forms.

purpose: 一组相关操作的弹出菜单。 / A popup of related actions.
guide: 使用 Trigger asChild 组合 Button；动作在 DropdownItem.onSelect 中执行。页面工具菜单通常用 modal={false}。 / Compose a trigger with asChild; handle actions with onSelect. Page tool menus usually use modal={false}.
api: Root: open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange, modal (Radix default true); Trigger: asChild; Content: sideOffset = 6, collisionPadding = 12; Item: onSelect, disabled, textValue
a11y: 方向键移动，Enter/Space 选择，Escape 关闭；文本不明确时传 textValue。 / Arrow keys navigate, Enter/Space select, Escape closes.
pitfalls: 不要用 onClick 代替菜单选择语义；不要将表单输入塞进操作菜单。 / Use selection semantics and keep form inputs outside action menus.

purpose: 需要用户专注的短任务。 / A focused, short task.
guide: 将 Trigger、Content、Close 放在同一个根内；受控模式用 open/onOpenChange。保存完成后由应用关闭。 / Compose Trigger, Content and Close in one root; control with open/onOpenChange when needed.
api: Root: open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange, modal = true; Content: title: ReactNode, closeLabel: string, description?: ReactNode; Radix Content props including onCloseAutoFocus
a11y: 保留焦点圈定和 Escape；title 命名面板，closeLabel 翻译关闭操作。关闭时焦点回触发器。 / Preserve focus trapping and Escape; translate title and closeLabel. Focus returns to the trigger.
pitfalls: 没有 Trigger 的程序化打开必须记住实际 opener，在 onCloseAutoFocus 阻止默认后将焦点还给它。不要在 ThemeProvider 外渲染浮层。 / Programmatic opening without a Trigger requires explicit opener focus restoration in onCloseAutoFocus. Keep overlays inside ThemeProvider.

purpose: 保留页面上下文的详情与编辑面板。 / Details and editing alongside page context.
guide: 将 Trigger、Content、Close 放在同一个根内；受控模式用 open/onOpenChange。保存完成后由应用关闭。 / Compose Trigger, Content and Close in one root; control with open/onOpenChange when needed.
api: Root: open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange, modal = true; Content: title: ReactNode, closeLabel: string, description?: ReactNode; Radix Content props including onCloseAutoFocus; side?: "left" | "right" | "start" | "end" = "end"
a11y: 保留焦点圈定和 Escape；title 命名面板，closeLabel 翻译关闭操作。关闭时焦点回触发器。 / Preserve focus trapping and Escape; translate title and closeLabel. Focus returns to the trigger.
pitfalls: 没有 Trigger 的程序化打开必须记住实际 opener，在 onCloseAutoFocus 阻止默认后将焦点还给它。不要在 ThemeProvider 外渲染浮层。 / Programmatic opening without a Trigger requires explicit opener focus restoration in onCloseAutoFocus. Keep overlays inside ThemeProvider.

purpose: 应用顶部与侧边导航结构。 / Top and side application navigation.
guide: Navbar 是 header；NavRail 是命名 nav。跳转 URL 用 NavLink；应用状态动作使用 NavItem。路由由应用处理。 / Navbar renders header, NavRail renders nav. Use NavLink for URLs and NavItem for app-state actions.
api: Navbar: native header props; NavRail: label: string, collapsed?: boolean = false; NavItem: native button props, active?, icon?; NavLink: native anchor props, active?, icon?
a11y: active 设置 aria-current="page"；多个导航区域使用不同名称。折叠时保留可访问名称。 / active sets aria-current="page"; name separate landmarks distinctly and retain labels when collapsed.
pitfalls: 不会自动导航或匹配路由；NavItem 不支持 href。 / Route matching is application-owned; NavItem does not accept href.

purpose: 窄屏下的模态导航。 / Modal navigation on narrow screens.
guide: 以受控 open 管理抽屉；完成导航后关闭。内容固定从左侧进入。 / Control open and close after navigation; content enters from the left.
api: Root/Trigger/Close: SideSheet equivalents; Content: title, closeLabel, navigationLabel required; description optional; side is always left
a11y: 面板标题与 navigationLabel 分别命名 dialog 和 nav；关闭后回到菜单触发器。 / Title and navigationLabel name the dialog and navigation landmark.
pitfalls: 不会随路由自动关闭，也不会自动判断断点。 / Breakpoints and close-on-navigation are application responsibilities.

purpose: 独立的渐进展开区域。 / A single disclosure region.
guide: 用于高级设置与补充信息；一组关联折叠项用 Accordion。 / Use for advanced settings; use Accordion for a related group.
api: Root: open/defaultOpen?: boolean, onOpenChange, disabled; Trigger: asChild; Content: forceMount and native div props
a11y: Trigger 自动管理 aria-expanded 与 aria-controls，Enter/Space 切换。 / Trigger manages expanded state and relationships; Enter/Space toggles.
pitfalls: 不要用 CSS 隐藏仍可聚焦的内容；需要状态持久化时将数据状态放在根外。 / Avoid hiding focusable content with CSS; lift persistent data state outside.

purpose: 多个相关的可展开章节。 / A group of disclosure sections.
guide: type="single" 使用字符串值，type="multiple" 使用字符串数组。single 可加 collapsible 允许全关闭。 / Single mode uses a string; multiple mode uses an array. collapsible allows closing the single open item.
api: Root: type: "single" | "multiple" required; value/defaultValue and onValueChange depend on type; Item: value: string; Trigger/Content: Radix props
a11y: 内置标题与按钮语义，方向键在标题间移动；标题应清晰独立。 / Built-in heading/button semantics and arrow-key navigation.
pitfalls: 不要在 Trigger 内再嵌套按钮。multiple 模式不接受 collapsible。 / Do not nest buttons in Trigger; collapsible belongs to single mode.

purpose: 切换同一上下文中的内容面板。 / Switch related content panels.
guide: 每个 Tab 与 TabPanel 使用相同唯一 value。慢速加载内容可设置 activationMode="manual"。 / Match unique values between tabs and panels; use manual activation for slow content.
api: Root: value/defaultValue, onValueChange, orientation = "horizontal", activationMode = "automatic"; TabList: aria-label; Tab/TabPanel: value required; Tab disabled?
a11y: 方向键导航，自动模式随焦点激活；手动模式 Enter/Space 激活。 / Arrow keys navigate; manual mode activates with Enter/Space.
pitfalls: 不是 URL 导航，也不是提交表单的偏好选择；分别使用 NavLink 和 SegmentedControl。 / Use NavLink for navigation and SegmentedControl for preferences.

purpose: 人物或组织的视觉身份。 / Person or organization identity.
guide: 提供图片 src 与短 fallback；图片加载失败时显示 fallback。 / Provide an image and a short fallback for loading or failure.
api: alt: string required; fallback: string required; src?: string; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md"; Radix Avatar.Root props
a11y: alt 同时用于图片和 fallback 的可访问名称。 / alt names both the image and fallback.
pitfalls: 不自带点击语义；可交互头像需放在有名称的按钮/链接内。 / An Avatar is not an interactive control.

purpose: 简短的类别或状态文字。 / A short category or status.
guide: 状态含义用文字表述，再选择对应 tone。 / State the meaning in text, then choose a tone.
api: tone?: "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" = "neutral"; native span props
a11y: 颜色之外保留状态文字；动态播报需求由外层 live region 负责。 / Keep text alongside color; add a live region when announcements are needed.
pitfalls: 没有 info tone，也不是可点击 chip。 / Badge has no info tone and is not an interactive chip.

purpose: 纵向排列的一组内容。 / A vertical set of items.
guide: List 渲染 ul；ListItem 渲染 li，leading/trailing 放身份与辅助操作。 / List is ul; ListItem is li with leading/trailing slots.
api: List: native ul props; ListItem: native li props plus leading?: ReactNode, trailing?: ReactNode
a11y: 保留列表语义；需要操作时使用真实 Button 或链接。 / Preserve list semantics and use actual controls for actions.
pitfalls: 不要只给 li 加 onClick 伪装成按钮；不自带选择、排序或虚拟滚动。 / Do not make a pointer-only clickable li; selection and virtualization are not included.

purpose: 需要按行列比较的结构化数据。 / Structured row-and-column data.
guide: 使用原生 caption、thead、tbody、th、td；宽表在自身容器横向滚动。 / Compose native table elements; wide tables scroll within their container.
api: Native table props; children are native table sections; className applies to table
a11y: 用 caption 命名表格，列标题 scope="col"、行标题 scope="row"。 / Name with caption and associate row/column headers using scope.
pitfalls: 不是 DataGrid，没有内置排序、筛选、行选择或分页。 / This is not a DataGrid; sorting, filtering and pagination are application-owned.

purpose: 跨页浏览数据的前后页控制。 / Previous/next data navigation.
guide: 页码从 1 开始；数据请求与页数计算由应用负责。筛选变化时同步校正 page。 / Pages are one-based; the application fetches data and clamps page after filtering.
api: page: number; pages: number; onPageChange: (page:number)=>void; label, previousLabel, nextLabel: string — all required
a11y: 命名导航区，边界按钮禁用，页码变化在 polite 区域播报。 / Named navigation, disabled boundary buttons and polite page announcements.
pitfalls: 不是从 0 开始；page 越界不会自动修正。 / Pages are not zero-based and out-of-range values are not auto-corrected.

purpose: 展示多阶段任务的位置。 / Show position in a multi-stage task.
guide: current 是从 0 开始的当前步骤索引；更早步骤标记完成。 / current is a zero-based index; earlier steps are complete.
api: steps: readonly {id:string;label:ReactNode;description?:ReactNode}[]; current:number; label:string — required
a11y: 有序列表，当前项 aria-current="step"；文字描述阶段。 / Ordered list with aria-current="step" and textual stage labels.
pitfalls: 不是导航控件；不会自动推进，也不提供每步错误状态。 / Steps is presentational and does not advance or track per-step errors.

purpose: 任务完成比例或未知时长进度。 / Determinate or indeterminate progress.
guide: value 使用 0–100；未知进度传 null 或省略。 / Use 0–100; omit value or pass null for indeterminate progress.
api: value?: number | null; aria-label or aria-labelledby; Radix Progress.Root props; max is always 100
a11y: 始终提供可访问名称，必要时在邻近文本解释正在进行的任务。 / Always name the progress indicator and explain the ongoing task.
pitfalls: 不要传 max={1000} 期望自定义范围；实现固定 100 并裁剪 value。 / max is fixed at 100 and values are clamped.

purpose: 内容加载时的占位轮廓。 / Loading placeholders.
guide: 尺寸接近最终内容以减少布局移动；外层标记 aria-busy 并提供加载说明。 / Match final dimensions and put aria-busy plus loading text on the containing region.
api: Native div props; style/className for dimensions; aria-hidden is always true
a11y: Skeleton 本身从可访问树隐藏；状态说明放在外层。 / Skeleton is hidden from assistive technology; expose status outside it.
pitfalls: 不能无限显示代替错误反馈；不要包含可聚焦子元素。 / Do not replace errors with an endless skeleton or nest focusable children.

purpose: 补充简短的非必要帮助文字。 / Brief supplementary help.
guide: 在应用或区域放一个 TooltipProvider；Tooltip 包裹单个可聚焦触发元素。 / Use a provider around the region and a single focusable trigger child.
api: Provider: Radix Tooltip.Provider props, delayDuration default 700ms; Tooltip: content: ReactNode, children: ReactNode
a11y: 鼠标悬停和键盘焦点都可触发；触发器本身必须有名称。 / Available on hover and focus; the trigger needs its own accessible name.
pitfalls: 不要放表单、按钮或关键说明；禁用按钮不能直接充当可靠触发器。 / Do not put interactive or essential content in a tooltip; disabled buttons are unreliable triggers.

purpose: 上下文中的成功、提示与错误反馈。 / Contextual feedback.
guide: 内容写明发生了什么和下一步；tone 按语义选择。 / Explain what happened and the next action; choose tone by meaning.
api: tone?: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" = "info"; native div props; default role alert for danger, status otherwise
a11y: danger 使用紧急播报，其他状态 polite；避免频繁更新导致重复播报。 / Danger is assertive; other tones use status. Avoid repeated announcements.
pitfalls: 没有内置 title、description 或关闭按钮；通过 children 组合。 / Compose children; there are no title, description or dismiss props.

purpose: 无数据时解释原因并提供下一步。 / Explain an empty result and a next action.
guide: 区分首次使用、无搜索结果与权限不足；action 提供有意义的下一步。 / Distinguish first use, no results and access restrictions.
api: title: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode
a11y: 标题渲染 h3；确保所在页面标题层级合理。图标是装饰性的。 / Title renders h3; keep a sensible heading hierarchy. The icon is decorative.
pitfalls: 加载、错误与空数据要分别处理；不要一律显示“暂无数据”。 / Handle loading, error and empty results separately.

purpose: 连续观测的变化趋势。 / Trends across observations.
guide: 按时间排序输入；用 null 表达缺失。 图表样式需在 UI CSS 后导入 @matrixzero/charts/styles.css。 进入和更新使用局部淡入，motion={false} 关闭；自动尊重减少动态效果。 / Sort observations by time and use null for gaps. Import charts/styles.css after UI CSS. Local opacity transitions on entry/update; set motion={false} to disable. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
api: title:string; data:readonly ChartDatum[]; series:readonly ChartSeries[]; description?:string; height?:number = 240 (min 180); locale?:string; labels?:ChartLabels; formatValue?, formatAxisValue?: (n:number)=>string; stacked?:boolean (area/bar only); motion?: boolean = true
a11y: 保留内置精确数据表；传 locale 与 labels 翻译文字，颜色不能是唯一编码。 / Keep the exact-value table and translate locale/labels; do not rely on color alone.
pitfalls: series.key 必须唯一且不能为 label；缺失值不能填 0。容器宽度必须大于 0。LineChart 的 stacked 无效果。 / Series keys must be unique and cannot be label. Do not convert missing values to zero. Container width must be nonzero; stacked does not affect LineChart.

purpose: 相对零点的规模，可选堆叠。 / Magnitude relative to zero, optionally stacked.
guide: 对比总量可堆叠；缺失较多时优先非堆叠图。 图表样式需在 UI CSS 后导入 @matrixzero/charts/styles.css。 进入和更新使用局部淡入，motion={false} 关闭；自动尊重减少动态效果。 / Stack for total magnitude; prefer unstacked charts when gaps matter. Import charts/styles.css after UI CSS. Local opacity transitions on entry/update; set motion={false} to disable. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
api: title:string; data:readonly ChartDatum[]; series:readonly ChartSeries[]; description?:string; height?:number = 240 (min 180); locale?:string; labels?:ChartLabels; formatValue?, formatAxisValue?: (n:number)=>string; stacked?:boolean (area/bar only); motion?: boolean = true
a11y: 保留内置精确数据表；传 locale 与 labels 翻译文字，颜色不能是唯一编码。 / Keep the exact-value table and translate locale/labels; do not rely on color alone.
pitfalls: series.key 必须唯一且不能为 label；缺失值不能填 0。容器宽度必须大于 0。LineChart 的 stacked 无效果。 / Series keys must be unique and cannot be label. Do not convert missing values to zero. Container width must be nonzero; stacked does not affect LineChart.

purpose: 离散类别间的数值比较。 / Compare discrete categories.
guide: 保持类别标签清晰；stacked 可表达组成，正负数分开堆叠。 图表样式需在 UI CSS 后导入 @matrixzero/charts/styles.css。 进入和更新使用局部淡入，motion={false} 关闭；自动尊重减少动态效果。 / Keep labels legible; stacked bars separate positive and negative totals. Import charts/styles.css after UI CSS. Local opacity transitions on entry/update; set motion={false} to disable. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
api: title:string; data:readonly ChartDatum[]; series:readonly ChartSeries[]; description?:string; height?:number = 240 (min 180); locale?:string; labels?:ChartLabels; formatValue?, formatAxisValue?: (n:number)=>string; stacked?:boolean (area/bar only); motion?: boolean = true
a11y: 保留内置精确数据表；传 locale 与 labels 翻译文字，颜色不能是唯一编码。 / Keep the exact-value table and translate locale/labels; do not rely on color alone.
pitfalls: series.key 必须唯一且不能为 label；缺失值不能填 0。容器宽度必须大于 0。LineChart 的 stacked 无效果。 / Series keys must be unique and cannot be label. Do not convert missing values to zero. Container width must be nonzero; stacked does not affect LineChart.

purpose: 非负数值占整体的比例。 / Nonnegative parts of a whole.
guide: 类别较少且总量有意义时使用；精确比较优先 BarChart。 进入和更新使用局部淡入，motion={false} 关闭；自动尊重减少动态效果。 / Use for a small number of meaningful parts; prefer BarChart for precise comparison. Local opacity transitions on entry/update; set motion={false} to disable. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
api: title:string; data:readonly {label:string;value:number;color?:string}[]; description?, height?, locale?, labels? (ChartLabels plus value?:string), formatValue?: (n:number)=>string; motion?: boolean = true
a11y: 提供标题与本地化 labels，保留数据表作为比例图的替代表示。 / Provide title and translated labels; retain the data table alternative.
pitfalls: 负数、非有限值和溢出总和会抛 RangeError；先校验外部输入或用错误边界。全零显示空态。 / Negative/nonfinite values and overflowing totals throw RangeError; validate inputs or use an error boundary. All-zero data is empty.

purpose: MDS 自有 SVG 图标，340 个稳定名称。 / MDS SVG icons with 340 stable names.
guide: 按名称静态导入便于 tree shaking；16、20、24px 为常用尺寸，目录从 @matrixzero/icons/catalog 导入。独立信息图标传 aria-label，装饰图标默认隐藏。Heart、Star、Bookmark、Bell 和 Flag 支持 outlined/filled；切换按钮同时设置 aria-pressed。 / Use named imports for tree shaking; common sizes are 16, 20 and 24px. Import the catalogue from @matrixzero/icons/catalog. Give standalone meaningful icons an aria-label; decorative icons are hidden by default. Heart, Star, Bookmark, Bell and Flag support outlined/filled; set aria-pressed on toggle buttons.
api: IconProps extends SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>; size?: number | string = 16; strokeWidth?: number = 1.75; absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean; aria-label/aria-labelledby; catalog: iconCatalog, IconName, IconCategory; variant?: "outlined" | "filled" = "outlined" (Heart, Star, Bookmark, Bell, Flag)
a11y: 默认装饰性 aria-hidden；独立有意义图标传 aria-label。图标按钮由 IconButton.label 命名。 / Decorative by default; use aria-label for meaningful standalone icons and IconButton.label for actions.
pitfalls: 不要在每个按钮中导入整套 catalog 动态查找；它会包含全部图标。 / Do not import the whole catalog for each button; it includes the entire collection.

purpose: 持续展示的提示、注意事项与操作说明。 / Persistent tips, cautions and instructions.
guide: 信息说明用 info，完成条件用 success，风险提示用 warning/danger，一般备注用 neutral。标题概括重点，正文说明原因，action 放真实按钮或链接。 / Choose the tone by meaning, summarize the point in title and put real actions in action.
api: tone?: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "neutral" = "info"; title?: ReactNode; children?: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode | false; action?: ReactNode; native div props
a11y: 默认 role="note"，不主动打断屏幕阅读器；图标是装饰性的。动态状态通知使用 Alert。 / Defaults to role="note" without live announcements; icons are decorative. Use Alert for dynamic status.
pitfalls: 不要只通过颜色传达风险；不要把整块 Callout 变成可点击容器。title 使用 strong，不隐式改变页面标题层级。 / Keep meaning in text and do not make the whole callout clickable. Title uses strong, not an implicit heading.

purpose: 页面顶部的窄条公告，用于影响整个页面的服务通知。 / A slim page-top announcement for service notices affecting the whole page.
guide: 放在页面顶部，保持短句、横向排列与少量操作；窄屏可换行，不截断重要信息。正文中的解释与提醒使用 Callout。 / Place at the page top with concise copy and inline actions. Wrap on narrow screens without hiding important information. Use Callout for contextual explanations in content.
api: label:string; title?:ReactNode; children?:ReactNode; tone?:"info"|"success"|"warning"|"danger"|"neutral" = "info"; icon?:ReactNode|false; action?:ReactNode; onDismiss?:()=>void requires dismissLabel:string
a11y: 默认命名 region，不自动抢占焦点或重复播报。关闭按钮必须翻译；移除通知时将焦点放到附近稳定控件。 / Named region without unsolicited focus or live announcements. Translate the dismiss label and restore focus near the notice after removal.
pitfalls: 不要自动定时消失，也不要通过颜色单独表达风险。需要实时状态播报时显式选用 Alert。 / Avoid automatic expiry and color-only meaning. Use Alert for live status.

purpose: 组织一组相关内容与操作。 / Group related content and actions.
guide: 用 Header 放标题和说明，Content 放主要内容，Footer 放操作；outlined 为默认，elevated 用于浮起的内容，subtle 用于低强调分组。 / Compose Header, Content and Footer; choose outlined, elevated or subtle by emphasis.
api: Card: native div props, variant?:"outlined"|"elevated"|"subtle" = "outlined"; Header/Content/Footer: div props; Title: heading props, as?:"h2"|"h3"|"h4"|"h5"|"h6" = "h3"; Description: p props
a11y: CardTitle 的标题级别跟随页面结构；交互使用实际链接或按钮。 / Match CardTitle to the page heading hierarchy and use real links or buttons.
pitfalls: Card 不是按钮，不自带选中态或点击语义；单选方案用 RadioCard。不要嵌套可点击的整卡与操作按钮。 / Card is not a selectable control; use RadioCard for choices and avoid nested interactive targets.

purpose: 限制内容宽度并留出两侧空白。 / Constrain content width with inline gutters.
guide: 默认最大宽度 1200px、居中、两侧 24px 留白；窄父容器保持流式宽度，留白不超过父容器的 10%。 / Defaults to 1200px maximum width, centered, with 24px gutters capped at 10% of the parent width.
api: maxWidth?:CSSProperties["maxWidth"] = 1200; gutter?:CSSProperties["paddingInline"] = 24; centered?:boolean = true; as?:"div"|"main"|"section"|"article"|"aside" = "div"; native div props
a11y: 需要页面主内容地标时 as="main"；不要嵌套 main，section/aside 用标题或 aria-label 命名。 / Use main for the primary landmark without nesting main; name sections and asides appropriately.
pitfalls: 数字单位为 px，maxWidth 包含左右内边距；不限制高度、不隐藏溢出内容。传 CSS 长度时使用非负值。 / Numbers are pixels and maxWidth includes gutters. Height and overflow are not constrained. Use nonnegative CSS lengths.

purpose: 为欢迎、新功能与引导提供柔和渐变背景。 / Soft gradient surfaces for welcomes, launches and onboarding.
guide: tone 选择 iris 蓝紫、mint 青绿或 peach 暖桃；正文使用 --mds-text，辅助文字放在靠下的稳定底色区域。与 Dialog、Button、Container 组合，不引入新的焦点或布局语义。 / Choose iris, mint or peach. Use --mds-text over the gradient and place muted copy on the lower stable surface. Compose with Dialog, Button and Container.
api: tone?: "iris" | "mint" | "peach" = "iris"; as?: "div" | "section" | "article" = "div"; native div props including children, className and style
a11y: 背景是装饰性 CSS，内容仍为正常 DOM。配色随 ThemeProvider 明暗/系统模式变化。默认没有持续动画；自定义配色时重新检查每个渐变位置的文字对比度。 / Decorative CSS preserves normal content semantics. Theme-aware palettes have no continuous animation. Recheck contrast across the entire gradient when overriding colors.
pitfalls: 不把状态含义仅编码为渐变颜色，不在上半部使用浅色辅助文字。背景不提供 modal 行为，弹窗仍使用 Dialog。 / Do not encode status through gradient color alone or use low-contrast muted text over the upper gradient. Use Dialog for modal behavior.

purpose: 以叠放头像展示团队成员。 / Show a compact group of people.
guide: 传入成员列表，max 控制可见头像数，剩余人数显示为 +N。支持 sm/md/lg。 / Pass members and cap visible avatars with max; remaining people appear as +N.
api: members: { name: string; fallback: string; src?: string }[]; label: string; overflowLabel: (count: number) => string; max?: number = 4; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md"; div props
a11y: label 命名整个组，每个头像使用成员姓名；overflowLabel 提供本地化剩余人数。 / Name the group and each person; localize the overflow label.
pitfalls: 人数标记不是按钮。如需查看完整成员列表，另提供有名称的按钮或链接。 / The count is informational; provide a separate named action to open a full member list.

purpose: 短暂的操作反馈，支持多条堆叠。 / Temporary feedback with stacked notifications.
guide: 在 ThemeProvider 内放 ToastProvider 和一个 Toaster；通过 useToast().toast 发送通知。默认 5 秒关闭，悬停或键盘聚焦展开并暂停计时。 / Place ToastProvider and one Toaster inside ThemeProvider. Call useToast().toast to notify. Notifications dismiss after 5 seconds; hover or keyboard focus expands the stack and pauses timers.
api: ToastProvider: children: ReactNode; duration?: number = 5000; label?: string; Toaster: label?: string; closeLabel?: string; useToast(): { toast(options: ToastOptions): number; dismiss(id: number): void; clear(): void }; ToastOptions: title: string; description?: ReactNode; tone?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger"; duration?: number; action?: { label: string; altText: string; onClick: () => void }
a11y: F8 聚焦通知，悬停、聚焦或窗口失焦时暂停计时。翻译 label、closeLabel 和 action.altText。 / F8 focuses notifications. Hover, focus and window blur pause timers. Translate label, closeLabel and action.altText.
pitfalls: 持久通知使用 duration: Infinity。重要表单错误仍应在字段旁展示；不要只通过短暂通知告知。 / Use duration: Infinity for persistent notifications. Keep important form errors beside their fields rather than only in a toast.
